svg.title: Every team on the instance, for a site admin — SoftTrack web design mockup (#307)
svg.desc: A site admin sees the teams they are on, like anybody else, and cannot say how many teams the instance has or which are abandoned. A page lists every team with its key, when it was created, its members, its admins, how many tickets and when something last happened, and lets a site admin appoint an admin, archive a team or delete an empty one. It shows no tickets.
